mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive despite UNRATE declining over the period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 4.5%, signaling tighter monetary policy, it compresses equity valuations and reduces future cash flow expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in household utilization (HOUST) above 50% indicates tight credit conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative despite HOUST crossing above 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a coordinated monetary and labor market expansion, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Rising gross domestic product (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) both indicate robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive despite simultaneous increases in GDPC1 and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts lower discount rates on equity cash flows, enhancing present value and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive despite FEDFUNDS declining in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: In a contractionary regime, a sustained drop in supplier activity (INDPRO) below its 50-month moving average indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative despite INDPRO declining in a contractionary regime.
